speaker: Xenodex
text: Fungaroth. A walking forest of red caps and root-legs. Every step leaves spores that sprout overnight. It guards its patch of ground like a castle wall.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Solarach. A tiny sun with one blazing eye, ringed by orbiting sparks. It burns hotter the braver its Linker is. Its glow can light a whole canyon.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Abyssor. A deep-sea leviathan whose blue body glows with spots like stars. A single lure on its head can call a storm off the open sea.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Forgemaul. An armored rhino of riveted iron with a hammerhead tail. It pounds scrap flat to build its own plating. Hank Briggs's oldest partner.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Mycora. A long-legged marsh bird with mushroom-cap wings. It sniffs out rot and sick roots, then eats them. Dr. Lysa Moor's research partner.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Anchorath. A sea serpent that drags a rusted anchor and is crusted with barnacles. It can hold a ship still in a gale. Captain Marsh's first mate.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Bassquake. A rabbit with speaker ears that thump out bass so deep the street shakes. Crowds follow its beat across Neonis. DJ Static's headliner.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Basaltor. A giant tortoise with a shell of cooling lava rock. It sleeps in magma pools and wakes to warm the mines. Old Basalt's friend for sixty years.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Glaciryx. A woolly mammoth with crystal tusks and frost-white fur. It can smell a hidden crevasse a mile away. Ingrid Vale's expedition partner.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Vexhydra. A three-headed serpent dripping green venom. Each head watches a different way, so nothing sneaks up on it. Admin Vex's favorite.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Bronnix. A bulldog in heavy bolted armor plates. Once it bites down it never lets go. Admin Bronn built and rebuilds its armor by hand.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Thornvoid. A lion with a mane of floating dark shards that bends gravity around it. Raised by Kael Thorne from a pod stolen from the crater.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Mirrix. A crystal spirit with a mirror for a face. Look into it and you see what you fear most. Echo's partner, and Reflix's twin.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Reflix. A crystal spirit of mirror-bright shards. Look into it and you see what you hope for most. Iris's partner, and Mirrix's twin.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Horizar. A shadow wolf circled by a ring of bent light, like the edge of a black hole. It guards doors that lead nowhere. Mortimer Kade's guardian.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Facetrix. A peacock with a tail of cut gemstones. It fans them to throw dazzling beams of light at its foes. Marisol Fenn's crown jewel.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Encorex. A rooster with a guitar-neck crest that crows in power chords. Its call starts every show and ends every fight. Duke Harrow's opening act.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Pyrelyth. A hooded spirit of living flame that never speaks. Its fire burns quietly, but it can scorch stone to glass. Saga's silent partner.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Citadrake. A walking fortress with towers and walls on its back. Nothing has ever broken through its stone. General Ostrander's unbreakable defense.

speaker: Xenodex
text: Firstlight. A glowing stag with antlers of pure light. Legend says it was the first Alienmon ever to bond with a human: Orra Venn, long ago.
